title: About
intro: We are an independent AI research lab based in Madrid, Spain. Our goal is to build and train agents that can reason, learn, and act in an uncertain world.

vision.heading: Our Vision
vision.body: We envision agents that can pursue long-term goals, adapt to changing circumstances, and evaluate how their actions affect themselves and others. We believe the best way to advance this research is through openness, sharing our code, models, and findings so others can build on them.

research.heading: Our Research
research.body: Our current work draws on probabilistic modeling and decision theory to develop tools for reasoning under uncertainty. Our broader research interests include reinforcement learning and multiagent systems. We are interested in how agents learn from experience, gather and exchange information, and coordinate their actions to make decisions over long time horizons.

funding.heading: Funding
funding.body: We are currently self-funded, using our own resources to bootstrap this initiative.
